text: Hi there! I'm PIP, and this is Mailwing, our mail ship.
We work for Cosmic Mail. We carry the stories of space explorers all the way home to Earth.
Every explorer has a file in the Cosmic Archive. Look how they're all connected.
Oh! That file just lost its connection.
And another one, and another. They're all going dark!
Hmm, that's strange. Let me take a closer look.
The Archive is trying to fix them, but the pieces don't fit together.
Oh no. Now none of the files can connect.
And some of my own memories are missing too.
I know these explorers, but I can't remember what they discovered.
Wait, I still remember two places where their signals came from!
If we fly there, we can find the explorers and fix their stories.
Lots of files are waiting, and their signals have gone quiet.
So, will you help me bring their stories home?
Let's make your Carrier ID! Type your name on the screen.
Your Carrier ID is saved in your mission album. Come on, I'll show you the cabin.
That book on the console is your mission album. Tap it to open it.
This first page is your Carrier ID. It shows your name and how many stories we've restored.
The Record page shows every explorer story and what we need to do next.
Now tap Stamps.
Every story we deliver to Earth earns a stamp here.
Now tap Discoveries.
Discoveries keeps the facts you find while exploring.
You can open your album any time. Tap Back to cabin to close it.
Now tap the navigation screen. It shows where the signals are coming from.
These are the places we can fly to. Tap one with a signal.
Great choice! Now tap Confirm route to set our course.
Welcome back, carrier! The Archive is waiting for our next delivery.
Route ready! Now press the big red button to take off.
Here we go. Let's bring this memory home.
We're here, explorer! The signal is somewhere ahead, let's go take a peek!
We made it to Mars! You flew like a real space carrier.
Listen! My antenna hears a tiny signal, and something out there needs our help.
To find it, we have a radar. It shows us where to go next.
Before we go, you need to know two tools. Tap the Radar card first.
The orange star shows where to go. Turn until it is at the top, then walk straight ahead!
Great job! Now tap the Scanner card.
The scanner looks at things up close. Aim at something that glows and hold to scan.
You're ready, carrier! Let's follow the signal together.
Follow the orange star on your radar. It leads to our practice rock!
Look, a glowing practice rock! Let's try your scanner on it.
Scan complete, you did it! Now let's follow the star to the signal.
Let's walk to the practice rock first. Follow the star!
Let's practice with the scanner first, then we'll take a closer look.
Whoa, look over there! Could that be our missing explorer?
Shh, it's an old rover napping in the dust! Press E to take a closer look.
Shh, it's an old rover napping in the dust! Tap Inspect to take a closer look.
Clue one: find the rover's eyes! They're way up at the top of its tall mast.
Clue two: find the rock tool! It's on the arm, down low at the front.
Last clue: find the heat reader! It peeked out through the mast, just below the eyes.
Beep boop, I remember now! This is Opportunity, a rover that hunted for clues about ancient water.
Let's help it remember! Press Q to grab your scanner.
Let's help it remember! Tap the scanner button to grab it.
Yes, the eyes! Opportunity's cameras took giant pictures, so scientists could pick where to drive.
Grind, grind! This tool scraped off a rock's dusty skin, so scientists could study the fresh rock inside.
This one could see invisible heat light! It found minerals that showed water was once here.
Psst! Look up high, at the top of the mast!
Psst! Check the arm, down low at the front!
Psst! Look at the tall mast, just below the eyes!
The eyes are still missing! Aim at the top of the mast and hold the scan button.
The rock tool is still missing! Aim at the arm, down low, and hold the scan button.
The heat reader is still missing! Aim at the mast, below the eyes, and hold the scan button.
Woohoo, all three parts! Its memory is coming back!
Sealed! Tap Watch its story to see Opportunity's adventure.
Story delivered! Follow the star back to our ship, explorer.
We're helping this explorer remember its parts. Follow the star on your radar!
Its tools are on the tall mast and on the arm. Aim there and hold to scan!
Try your scanner on the mast and the arm, explorer!
Some parts are still missing. The explorer is waiting for us!
The letter is ready! Let's walk back to our ship.
This story is safe on Earth now. Great job, explorer!
Its memory is back! Seal the letter, then let's walk back to our ship.
This story is safe now! You can see it in your mission album anytime.
The air here is super thin. Every dust grain has been waiting a looong time!
Those rocks look ancient. I bet they have amazing stories!
We did it! Opportunity is quiet now, but its discoveries will never be forgotten.
The Cosmic Scanner can read the landscape too. Aim at a big rock or a layered outcrop and hold the scan.
Beep boop, I remember now! This is Spirit, a rover that read the rocks for clues about ancient water.
Yes, the eyes! Spirit's cameras took giant pictures, so scientists could pick where to drive.
Its memory is back! Tap Seal the letter to keep its story safe.
Sealed! Tap Watch its story to see Spirit's adventure.
Record saved! Now tap the big button and send it home to Earth!
Whoosh, it made it! The story is safe on Earth, and you earned a new stamp!
We did it! Spirit is quiet now, but its discoveries will never be forgotten.
Not yet, explorer! Let's find all three parts first, I'll help you!
There's our ship! Press E to climb aboard.
There's our ship! Tap Board to climb aboard.
Look, it's Mars! Two old explorers are hiding down there, tap a glowing spot to pick one!
That's Meridiani Planum, a wide flat plain. Someone is waiting there!
That's Gusev Crater, a giant bowl in the ground. Someone is waiting there!
Hold on tight, we're going down!
We have a story aboard! Let's watch it and send it to Earth.
One story saved! Let's visit the other explorer, tap the glowing spot!
We already saved this story! Let's try the other spot.
Both stories are safe! Let's fly home to the cabin, explorer.
